fields.name: client_id
fields.help: OAuth 2.0 client id (Google Cloud console > Credentials) of a project with the Google Sheets API enabled.

fields.name: client_secret
fields.help: The OAuth client's secret, sent in the form body of the refresh_token grant.

fields.name: refresh_token
fields.help: Refresh token from Google's consent flow (offline access) with scope https://www.googleapis.com/auth/spreadsheets (or drive.file for files the app created); the runtime mints hourly access tokens from it.

config_fields.name: spreadsheet_id
config_fields.help: The spreadsheet id (the long id in https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/<id>/edit) that every tool reads and writes.

me.note: GET /v4/spreadsheets/{spreadsheet_id}?fields=spreadsheetId,properties.title,sheets.properties: confirms the token can open the configured spreadsheet and lists its sheets (tabs).

list_items.note: GET /v4/spreadsheets/{id}/values/{range}: collection is an A1 range such as Sheet1!A1:F200 (default A1:Z1000 of the first sheet); each item is one row, its cell values in `cells` (trailing empty cells omitted). The range bounds the rows; page, limit and query are not used.

get_item.note: GET /v4/spreadsheets/{id}/values/{range}: item_id is an A1 range (Sheet1!B2:D4); content is the 2-D array of values.

create_item.note: POST /v4/spreadsheets/{id}/values/{range}:append?valueInputOption=USER_ENTERED&insertDataOption=INSERT_ROWS with {values: fields.values}: appends rows after the table found in collection (an A1 range, default A1). Pass fields = {"values": [["a", 1], ["b", 2]]}; the returned id is the written range.

update_item.note: PUT /v4/spreadsheets/{id}/values/{range}?valueInputOption=USER_ENTERED with {values}: overwrites the A1 range item_id with fields.values (a 2-D array).

delete_item.note: POST /v4/spreadsheets/{id}/values/{range}:clear: clears the values (not formatting) of the A1 range item_id; rows are not removed.

not_offered.generate_image: Google Sheets has no generation endpoints.
not_offered.generate_video: Google Sheets has no generation endpoints.
not_offered.get_job: Sheets API calls are synchronous; there are no jobs.

evidence: host sheets.googleapis.com: DNS ok, TLSv1.3 (Google Trust Services)
probe: 6/6 tools answered on their documented path with an auth refusal, a validation error or data; control route -> 400 (client_error), so the answers are path-specific
spec https://sheets.googleapis.com/$discovery/rest?version=v4: 6/6 tools match (path, method, parameters, body keys, response paths)
scopes spreadsheets: all listed in the discovery document
